mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(step_order), 0) FROM investigation_step WHERE investigation_id = #{investigationId}
SELECT id, investigation_id, run_id, step_order, step_type, summary, payload_json, created_at FROM investigation_step WHERE investigation_id = #{investigationId} ORDER BY step_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO investigation_step (investigation_id, run_id, step_order, step_type, summary, payload_json) VALUES (#{investigationId}, #{runId}, #{stepOrder}, #{stepType}, #{summary}, #{payloadJson})
